Name: Perfection Tweaker
Author: shekurika
Description:
This mod allows you to customize how many things you need to have to achieve Perfection. This is mainly useful for heavily modded playthroughs were some fish/recipes/crafting recipes are not actually obtainable, preventing you from achieving Perfection. Additionally, it also allows you to check if you need to have certain things like all stardrops found.

[b]How to use:[/b]
I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to edit the config.
After loading your save, the mod will display how many items/NPCs/recipes/fish have been found in the console .
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DHCyTB2.png[/img]
Go to your game options, scroll to the bottom and click on "Mod Options" and change the values to your liking.

[b]Note:
[/b]This mod is most likely incompatible with mods that change the goals needed to achieve Perfection.
